## МТС Банк — Company.id 4776

```json

  "countryCode": "RU",
  "fullTitle": null,
  "id": 4776,
  "title": "\u041c\u0422\u0421 \u0411\u0430\u043d\u043a",
  "url": "mtsbank.ru"
}
```

Frozen base commit: `a748b01de5b7f29dfdd5eb19dadb40881ae4b8ca`. Checked: `2026-10-01T21:09:03.954265Z`.

### Exact versions and source

- Current/base SVG: [base.svg](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/3078833d75772832feddafe39fefc6b2948c0b75/review-materials/4776/base.svg) — SHA-256 `09e02451785465124403ba231879d9cc27f5ac06b57be72df030e4ba801d1c13`.

- Exact base-to-final changes: [candidate.diff](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/3078833d75772832feddafe39fefc6b2948c0b75/review-materials/4776/candidate.diff).
- Source page: [https://www.mtsbank.ru/upload/static/favicons/icon.svg](https://www.mtsbank.ru/upload/static/favicons/icon.svg).
- Source asset: [https://www.mtsbank.ru/upload/static/favicons/icon.svg](https://www.mtsbank.ru/upload/static/favicons/icon.svg).

### Evidence and judgment

- official checked 2026-10-01T20:52:00Z: [https://www.mtsbank.ru/upload/static/favicons/icon.svg](https://www.mtsbank.ru/upload/static/favicons/icon.svg); asset [https://www.mtsbank.ru/upload/static/favicons/icon.svg](https://www.mtsbank.ru/upload/static/favicons/icon.svg). Fetched asset page/bytes: official 120x120 SVG favicon, white square with red #e30611 egg, no text; sha256 e7511b70e0e389782720f6a0c8bb46bc86f71de6a86c0713ce70b1b5c0a832ec via packaged-CA retry \(receipt \[local artifact not published; reference omitted\]\). (independence group: mtsbank.ru primary).
- official checked 2026-10-01T20:52:00Z: [https://www.mtsbank.ru/](https://www.mtsbank.ru/); asset [https://www.mtsbank.ru/upload/static/favicons/icon.svg](https://www.mtsbank.ru/upload/static/favicons/icon.svg). Official favicon: standalone 120x120 SVG, white square, red egg, no text. Direct TLS to mtsbank.ru fails from this environment; retrieved through the helper's packaged-CA retry \(receipt \[local artifact not published; reference omitted\]\), sha256 e7511b70e0e389782720f6a0c8bb46bc86f71de6a86c0713ce70b1b5c0a832ec, matching Sep 2026 Wayback captures. (independence group: mtsbank.ru primary).
- third-party checked 2026-10-01T20:47:00Z: [https://web.archive.org/web/2026/https://www.mtsbank.ru/upload/static/favicons/icon.svg](https://web.archive.org/web/2026/https://www.mtsbank.ru/upload/static/favicons/icon.svg). Sep 2026 archive captures of the same favicon URL show the same red-egg-on-white mark; confirms continued use, not merely a stale live asset. (independence group: web.archive.org mirrors of mtsbank.ru).
- official checked 2026-10-01T20:35:00Z: [https://www.mtsbank.ru/about/press/](https://www.mtsbank.ru/about/press/). 2020 bank brandbook describes red background + egg mark; no open official SVG download besides the favicon. og:image uses egg + 'МТС БАНК' lockup \(wordmark text, not standalone, rejected\). (independence group: mtsbank.ru primary).
- third-party checked 2026-10-01T20:45:00Z: [https://apps.rustore.ru/app/ru.lewis.dbo](https://apps.rustore.ru/app/ru.lewis.dbo). Bank's consumer app is rebranded 'МТС Деньги' with a wallet-monogram icon — a product mark, not the bank mark; rejected as candidate. (independence group: RuStore listing).
- zenplugins-issue checked 2026-10-01T20:33:00Z: [https://api.github.com/search/issues?q=repo%3Azenmoney%2FZenPlugins+%22%D0%9C%D0%A2%D0%A1+%D0%91%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%BA%22+is%3Aissue](https://api.github.com/search/issues?q=repo%3Azenmoney%2FZenPlugins+%22%D0%9C%D0%A2%D0%A1+%D0%91%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%BA%22+is%3Aissue). 1 result: issue #925 \(open, balance-display bug\), not icon-related. (independence group: github search).
- zenplugins-pr checked 2026-10-01T20:33:00Z: [https://api.github.com/search/issues?q=repo%3Azenmoney%2FZenPlugins+%22%D0%9C%D0%A2%D0%A1+%D0%91%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%BA%22+is%3Apr](https://api.github.com/search/issues?q=repo%3Azenmoney%2FZenPlugins+%22%D0%9C%D0%A2%D0%A1+%D0%91%D0%B0%D0%BD%D0%BA%22+is%3Apr). 0 results. (independence group: github search).
- Independent evidence: Primary official favicon plus an independent archive mirror of the same URL; identity further corroborated by the brandbook description of the egg mark..
- Identity: confirmed — Fetched favicon is МТС Банк's own egg mark on the bank's official domain; egg geometry matches the accepted mark \(ratio 0.727 vs 0.714\)..
- Currency: confirmed — Served live on mtsbank.ru today and present in Sep 2026 archive captures; 2023 parent rebrand did not replace the bank's egg..
- Variant: confirmed — Official current standalone presentation is red egg on white square \(#e30611\); accepted inverse white-on-red-circle presentation is not the currently served standalone variant..
- Uncertainty: Exact brand-color #e30611 vs accepted #dd1220 is taken from the served asset; no accessible brandbook file states the standalone icon spec directly..

Rationale: Official current standalone mark of МТС Банк \(red egg on white square\) replaces the accepted superseded inverse presentation \(white egg on red circle\)..
Role: standalone app/favicon mark \(egg symbol on a white square tile\); variant: current official: red #e30611 egg on white; accepted baseline is the inverse white-on-red-circle presentation.
Visible difference: Tile presentation inverted and brand red corrected: accepted icon shows a white egg on a red disc; current official mark is the red egg on a white square. Difference is a supported current-design update, clearly visible in both before/after pairs..
Details: Egg silhouette and white square identical between working, optimized and official source; no detail loss.. Proportions: Egg proportions preserved \(ratio ~0.727\); square tile centered; no stretching in renders..

Source-to-final transformations:
- SVGO 4.1.0 with the repository svgo.config.mjs \(config sha256 f2a406e05dd8849e35cd5d2ce96862b6e160b135135064ceafd64efd126f477e\), multipass; 2102 -\> 444 bytes; optimized bytes selected as the final candidate \(sha256 4764c58aa88c36003e94428820a24a80f223235304608b48dadf1a8a40655f38\). No geometry transformation was needed; serialization-only optimization.
- No geometric transformation: the source 120x120 SVG geometry is kept and scaled by the catalog renderer.

### Light and dark before/after

![Before and after — light background](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/3078833d75772832feddafe39fefc6b2948c0b75/review-materials/4776/comparison-light.png?raw=true)

![Before and after — dark background](https://github.com/zenmoney/banks/blob/3078833d75772832feddafe39fefc6b2948c0b75/review-materials/4776/comparison-dark.png?raw=true)

### Render checks and limits

Desktop renderer recorded: `offscreen CPU Skia/painterResource` at `2026-10-01T21:06:49.440754761Z`. Source/final: Official source raster/librsvg reference and the final SVG are visually identical \(same egg, same red, same white square\).; base/final and rendering: Offscreen CPU Skia/painterResource light and dark 240px frames: final renders the red egg on a white square cleanly on both backgrounds, no clipping, distortion or color invention; base shows the old inverse disc mark. Candidate fits the square cell on both themes.

- android-compose: not-tested (available: false) — The local Android SDK installation lacks the emulator component and system images, so a headless Android check is impossible this run. Risk: the Android Compose render path is unobserved..
- android-native: not-tested (available: false) — Same missing emulator prerequisites; not run. Risk: native Android path unobserved..
- ios-compose: not-tested (available: false) — No iOS runtime on this Linux host; not run. Risk: iOS Compose path unobserved..
- ios-native: not-tested (available: false) — No iOS toolchain on this Linux host; not run. Risk: native iOS path unobserved..

Desktop observation is for the generated XML through Compose Desktop `painterResource`, not a claim of successful Android/iOS or native-widget rendering. Unavailable targets remain untested; reviewer visual approval and merge remain separate decisions.
